findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes every body in the file — `chargeConj`, `valenceNumber`, `IsChargeConsistent`, `LightFlavor.charge`, the numeric `piPlus`/`kPlus`, `ofMasses`, `IsIsospinLimit`, `IsSU3Limit` — although each already has a `(rfl)`-proved restatement. summary: The characteristic API of the concrete data is incomplete: no `mass`/`decayConstant` lemmas for `piPlus`/`kPlus`, no `Finset.univ` lemma for the new `Fintype LightFlavor`, no reachable accessors for `piMinus`/`kMinus`, and the file-wide `@[expose]` substitutes defeq for those missing lemmas. Several normal-form lemmas also lack `@[simp]`.
